title: MEMA community resiliency hub network plan
summary: Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) has selected a contractor to write a strategic plan for a community resiliency hub network, which would connect nonprofits with facilities and services that can aid response and recovery. The administrator expects the plan within two to three months. The request for proposals was delayed about a year by procurement language problems; the agency planned to use a remaining $150,000 for the plan.

timeline.text: The administrator said the strategic plan would be completed in two to three months.
He said vendors submitted bids and one vendor was selected.
He said the request for proposals was delayed about a year by problems with procurement language.
The administrator said the network would connect nonprofits that have facilities and services that can help in response and recovery.
